Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Ninth Quill
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Research

A planning table, miniature terrain for walls and furniture, and tomes on magical security, architecture, and spycraft.

Research: Reconnaissance. The hireling sends spies for 7 days to study a building within 50 miles of your Bastion, then sets up a model of it on the table. Public areas are accurate; private areas are shown only roughly; areas concealed by magic or guarded by powerful creatures may be wrong or missing, at the DM's discretion. The spies avoid all creatures, so little is known of the inhabitants. The model remains until your next Research order here, though it can grow outdated if the building changes.

Heist Preparations. A character who prepares a theft or infiltration with the model for at least 8 hours chooses a role. Its benefit applies within 1 mile of the modeled building for 7 days or until they prepare again: Enforcer, Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks; Face, Charisma (Deception); Lookout, Wisdom (Perception); Medic, Wisdom (Medicine); Sneak, Dexterity (Stealth); Thief, Dexterity (Sleight of Hand).

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, it becomes Vast: Reconnaissance reaches buildings within 500 miles, and a character preparing a heist can take two roles.

Source: Arcana Unleashed.
